issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning int, but the template's TODO hint and the reference solution implement and document this method as returning double. This mismatch between the UML and the implementation guidance/solution can confuse students about the expected return type and may cause them to implement the method with the wrong type, failing tests or causing compilation/type errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected return type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (to match the template hint and solution) and ensure any textual descriptions state the method returns a double. Alternatively, if an integer result is intended, change the template hint and the solution implementation to return int and update tests/documentation accordingly.
